fields.statement: Verifier at 4f1bc3c3: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestShipCheckStabilityRecord -v -count=1 passed all five subtests: a green first attempt is recorded once as a clean run (head, PR 7, not main, green, time set, no flakes, a repeat check adds nothing); a red head whose rerun passes records nothing before the rerun settles, then one green entry with flakes TestGarden and TestPond read from the first attempt's --log-failed; a head still red after its rerun records one red entry with no flake; a tree-equal ship check --main records a green main entry for merge commit fff0000aaa with no gh run call; a tree-differing one records the dispatched run's green on main. Re-run with all TestShip* tests from a clean git-archive copy outside ~/code (RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset): ok. go vet and gofmt clean on internal/api. Read the diff: recordSettledCI hooks the settled paths in runShipCheck, shipCheckMainTree and shipCheckMainDispatch after shipRerunFailed (so a rerun records nothing until it settles), dedups per (head, main), skips dry runs, keeps 500 entries under the git common dir; RerunTests are captured only on a head's first rerun. In-tree, the full internal/api package hit the rootguard on .rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which the live root daemon rewrites on its own (mtime moved with no test running), and the 600s default timeout under VM load; both are environmental, not this change.
